bundle.shortDescription: Read what your AI writes. Write what it reads. A free, open-source Markdown app.
bundle.longDescription: PerMark opens any Markdown file as a clean page you can edit, keeps notes that save themselves, and turns a project folder into an IDE where you follow, review and steer what your AI agents write. It works with any AI tool, or with none.
